name: Verizon (postpaid mobile)
why: Largest U.S. wireless carrier (~147M connections per catalog); top of the category ranking.

name: T-Mobile (postpaid)
why: Second-largest national carrier; distinct T-Life / My T-Mobile billing site.

name: AT&T Wireless (postpaid)
why: Third national carrier (~121M connections per catalog); myAT&T billing.

name: Cricket Wireless
why: Largest prepaid brand on AT&T's network; its own cricketwireless.com Pay Bill / Quick Pay site.

name: Metro by T-Mobile
why: Largest prepaid brand on T-Mobile's network; separate metrobyt-mobile.com account and Express Pay.

name: Boost Mobile
why: Fourth facilities-based national brand (~7.5M customers per catalog); boostmobile.com account.

name: Xfinity Mobile
why: Largest cable MVNO; Xfinity Mobile bill is separate from other Xfinity services.

name: Spectrum Mobile
why: Second-largest cable MVNO; separate Spectrum Mobile billing with mandatory Auto Pay.

name: Visible (by Verizon)
why: Major app/online-only prepaid brand with its own visible.com account (distinct from Verizon postpaid billing).

name: Google Fi Wireless
why: Well-known national MVNO billed through fi.google.com; chosen over Consumer Cellular, whose help pages sit behind a bot check and could not be researched.

name: Mint Mobile
why: Best-known online-only MVNO (T-Mobile owned); own mintmobile.com account with multi-month plans and Auto Renewal.

name: Consumer Cellular
why: Large postpaid MVNO aimed at 50+ customers; My Account at consumercellular.com (support pages now load without the bot check that blocked tier 1).

name: Straight Talk Wireless
why: Largest Verizon Value prepaid brand (Walmart); own straighttalk.com refill, Auto Pay and Extended Pay.

name: Total Wireless (Total by Verizon)
why: Major Verizon prepaid brand with its own totalwireless.com account, guest payment and Wallet.

name: Tracfone
why: Long-running prepaid brand (Verizon Value) with its own tracfone.com refill and Auto-Refill.

name: C Spire
why: Largest privately held U.S. carrier (~1.2M per catalog); postpaid billing with Express Pay at cspire.com.

name: Claro Puerto Rico
why: Largest Puerto Rico carrier (~1.6M per catalog); Mi Claro and Mi Claro Express billing.

name: Tello Mobile
why: Popular online-only prepaid MVNO with self-service cancel and auto-renewing 30-day plans at tello.com.

name: Ultra Mobile
why: Well-known international-calling prepaid MVNO with its own my.ultramobile.com account and Auto Renew.

name: Cellcom (Wisconsin)
why: Largest regional carrier in the ranking after the skipped ones (~300K); myCellcom and Quik|Pay billing.
